title: Retail Installment Contracts Contract Terms: The Payoff Amount and Payoff Interest
content:
**Payoff amount.** The payoff amount of a contract under Retail Installment Contracts is the principal balance plus fees due plus payoff interest through the posting date, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Payoff interest.** Payoff interest is simple interest at the contract's APR on the principal balance, actual/365, counted in calendar days from the latest posted payment — the payment with the latest posting date, and among payments of the same date the one recorded first — or from the contract date if none has posted, through the payoff good-through date, the new interest rounded half-up to the cent, together with the unpaid interest carried, or, where that latest posted payment was returned, together with the interest portion its return reversed instead.

**Good-through date and assembly.** Review days can be added; a payoff taken on the posting date is then good through the posting date plus every review day added — its payoff good-through date — and the per diem runs through that date as on a payoff statement, so the payoff amount is the principal balance plus fees due plus payoff interest through the payoff good-through date, rounded half-up to the cent. Its principal and fee portions are the principal balance and fees due, the rest is its interest portion, and the payoff closes the contract.

| Portion of the payoff payment | Amount |
|---|---|
| principal | the principal balance |
| fees | the fees due |
| interest | the rest of the payoff amount |

## Worked figures (hypothetical contract)

Principal 5200.00 at 23.50%; fees due 0.00; unpaid interest carried 3.10; latest posted payment 18 days before the posting date, not returned; no review day added, so the payoff good-through date is the posting date.

- New interest: 5200.00 multiplied by 23.50% by 18, divided by 365, that is 60.263…, rounded to 60.26.
- Payoff interest: 60.26 plus 3.10, that is 63.36.
- Payoff amount: 5200.00 plus 0.00 plus 63.36, that is 5263.36; the interest portion is 63.36.

With 2 review days added the interest would run 20 days: 66.96 of new interest, 70.06 of payoff interest and a payoff amount of 5270.06.
